description: Free-text search over the SFXMint library of free CC0 sound effects. Use it for sound descriptions, additional constraints or gaps left by another tool. Choose get_role_sound for a named event or get_sound_set for multiple events when that fits the task; these are task branches, not a fixed sequence. Hard constraints (duration, loop, format, excluded words) always apply. results hold sounds whose text has every word of the query. When there are none, closest lists the nearest sounds that meet every hard constraint, best first, each with missing_terms: judge them from title and description and let the user listen. library_fit says how well the library covers the request (full, close, weak, none); anything short of full also returns generation options (generate_available; type ambience or bgm for looping environments or background music; use its mcp_tool when present and authorized, or its Studio page). Returns direct, hotlinkable MP3/WAV URLs and verified OGG (Vorbis) URLs where available — no API key, no attribution required — plus measured acoustics (attack_ms, tail_ms, centroid_hz), character labels like 'bright · punchy · tight', loop/file-QC status, and score/match as ranking evidence only (role = known role default, exact = all words hit, partial = some words hit, semantic = nearest by meaning).

category.description: Optional category slug: ui, retro-game, transition, impact, ambience, water, fire-electric, footsteps, door, mechanical, paper-fabric, glass, animal, crowd, cartoon, magic-scifi, horror, feedback, instrument, office, human, vehicle, household

format.description: Delivery format (ogg = Ogg Vorbis, only sounds published before 2026-10-14 have it); loop=true defaults to WAV when omitted.

loop.description: Require (true) or exclude (false) a candidate marked with prepared loop metadata; seam evidence is returned separately.

max_duration_ms.description: Hard maximum length of the sound in milliseconds: a file may run longer with near-silence after the sound (audible_ms is the sound, duration_ms the file; checks say which was met).

query.description: Use concise English search terms for the source or event, action and essential audible traits from the user's request or project context: 'door slam', 'soft UI confirmation chime', 'coin pickup'. A single clear source such as 'thunder' is valid; do not pad it. Translate other languages while preserving meaning. Avoid full generation prompts, app backstory, synonym lists and invented materials or environments: full matches must cover every query word. Put duration, loop and format requirements in their separate fields. If no full match exists, inspect closest and missing_terms; simplify only optional wording, never silently drop a required trait.

name: search_sounds
